verdict.rationale: The Teams/Graph API docs reference a versioned API surface: links in the channel-post-messages docs carry 'view=graph-rest-1.0', which implies a v1.0 release channel. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, notice periods or a versioning guarantee, so only half the story is glancingly supported. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy and timelines, explicit versioning documentation (e.g. v1.0 vs beta stability guarantees), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
